request.body:
## Scope

Follow-up to the endpoint check of `C04-to-C16-reconstruction` on #178 (finding F3 of report PR #248, `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C16/endpoints/ADB991-claude-20261113-a112/mathematics.md`; acknowledgement https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/178#issuecomment-6863705366). Package **C04** (#45, closed). Parent: #26. Coordinator: @hairer. Base: `codex/existence-monograph` (`69b2631`). Source pin: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`.

Task kind: explain (bounded author revision of C04).

## Mathematical interface

The public target `ex-reconstructed` (`statement.tex`) contains the clause "at least one smeared field is nonzero" (source: field `acts` of `Reconstructed`, `Lean/ChallengeSpec.lean`). C04 proves only "every nonzero union label gives a nonzero smeared field" (`prop:boundary-detection`, `prop:word-locality`). With E = {0} all C04 hypotheses hold and every field vanishes, so a nonzero label must be produced. The C04 ledger records this as review M3 (row `C04-to-C16-endpoint`).

The source route (`HierarchyBridge.publicReconstruction`, first bullet) is: the grade-0 unit class `YM.Table.unit 0` is nonzero by `YM.Table.alive` (`Lean/YM/Euclid/Null.lean`, from `YM.Table.Basic.unital` and `.trivial`, `Lean/YM/Euclid/Table.lean`), its union image is nonzero by `YM.Table.pin_inj`, and faithfulness of the realization gives a test with a nonzero field.

Treatment: **prove** the short corollary in C04 after `prop:boundary-detection`, stating the unit law and normalization of the limiting original table as an **explicitly named outstanding input** (no manuscript chapter currently states it for the limiting original table; `prop:ex-limits-euclidean` carries normalization but not the unit law). Producing that input in C03 (`limits.tex`) is **not** in scope; it is recorded as a proposed follow-up for the C03 limits owner.

## Owned outputs and exclusions

- `manuscript/existence/boundary-detection.tex` (new corollary after `prop:boundary-detection`; no change to existing statements);
- `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C04/` author records (`ledger.md`, `correspondence.md`, a new dated record file); not `review/`.

Excluded: `complex-heat.tex` (PR #203 and the F1 coordinate wording), `limits.tex` and other C03 chapters, E4 (field levels, inclusions, union; owner unidentified), C16 chapters, `Lean/`.

## Prerequisites and overlap search

None blocking. Open PRs at 20:15 UTC touch no file listed above (checked PR file lists: #203 touches `complex-heat.tex` only; #211/#219 touch only review folders).

## Acceptance criteria

A corollary with a detailed proof and an explicitly stated input; ledger rows updated (endpoint row and a new input row with a proposed owner); monograph build with the changed page inspected; blueprint checker and tests run. Independent mathematics and textual Lean-correspondence review by a different account. Claim on this issue following `docs/coordination.md` before starting.
